text:
Elaine: hey @people-ops, wrapping up week 1 — my health insurance card still shows as "pending activation" in the benefits portal. also my W-4 status in the payroll portal says 'awaiting review'. who should I ping to get both moving?
People Ops: hi Elaine — welcome again! sorry for the holdup. can you confirm you uploaded a photo ID and dependent docs (if you added dependents)? sometimes the card emissary waits on that.
Elaine: uploaded ID yesterday (front/back) and filled out dependents = none. got the confirmation email from the benefits vendor but card status didn't change.
Sam (Payroll): looping in payroll — @Elaine, W-4 pending usually means the PDF didn't parse. can you re-download your submitted W-4 from the portal and attach it here or upload to HR portal > tax docs? sometimes the e-signing step fails silently.
Elaine: ok grabbing it now. attaching a screenshot of the portal error: """
Error: Document parse failed (code 422)
Please re-upload a clear scan or use the mobile capture
"""
Toni: fyi we had a vendor outage yesterday that caused a few parse failures. if it's the same error we can manually mark it after we verify the file. @People Ops, do we have a ticket template for manual verification?
People Ops: yes — if parse fails, send the file (pdf/png) + employee ID + submitter email to hr-ops@redwood.com. we will verify and hand off to payroll for manual entry. can someone confirm elaine's employee id so sam can do the manual update?
Elaine: employee id: RWI-3489. attaching the freshly downloaded signed W-4 (pdf). also attaching my benefits confirmation email.
Payroll Bot: automated upload received: file=W4_RWI-3489.pdf size=132KB status=queued. ETA manual review ~ <24h.
Sam (Payroll): thanks — i'll pick this up. i will also ping the benefits vendor to force re-activation on the card. Elaine, you should get an updated portal email within the day. if not, ping me and i'll escalate.
Elaine: awesome, thank you! also quick Q — can I submit a one-off expense for the relocation internet reimbursement now or should I wait until card is active?
People Ops: you can submit the reimbursement now via Expensify (company policy). tag category 'Relocation' and add the offer letter relocation clause #. we approve payroll reimbursements only after tax docs are processed, but expensify reimbursements can go through separate queue.
Elaine: perfect. sending that shortly. appreciate the quick help :heart:
Sam (Payroll): confirming i've updated W-4 status to 'processed' in payroll and kicked the manual activation request for the benefits card. watch for two emails: payroll confirmation + benefits activation.
Payroll Bot: status_update: payroll=W-4 processed for RWI-3489 at 1918201399; benefits=activation request submitted to vendor at 1918201400.
Elaine: got them both! card now says 'active' and payroll shows withholding applied. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
People Ops: yay! tagging this thread resolved. if any followups pop up (card not arriving physically), DM benefits-team.
